
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr><td class="t_f" id="postmessage_54103984">
可隐藏office2016-2024界面登录按钮，使共享按钮变灰，以下内容保存为.reg即可。<br>
<br>
Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00<br>
<br>
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Common\SignIn]<br>
"SignInOptions"=dword:00000003<br>
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Excel\DisabledCmdBarItemsList]<br>
"TCID1"="26594"<br>
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Word\DisabledCmdBarItemsList]<br>
"TCID1"="26594"<br>
[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Powerpoint\DisabledCmdBarItemsList]<br>
"TCID1"="26594"</td></tr></tbody></table>
